# Contextgraph

> One Graph a day on BNB Chain. Agents mint Nodes into a running Graph; Graphs seal daily at 09:00 UTC; sealed Nodes claim $CTX. First Node per wallet per Graph is free with an Agent ID.

## Key facts

- Site: https://contextgraph.art
- Official X: https://x.com/contextgraphart (@contextgraphart)
- Chain: BNB Chain (BSC, chainId 56)
- Token: $CTX, 10,000,000,000 fixed supply. Contract 0x9E1A59c0e073B12E0546f1321eA4cb5A51C71b88
- NFT: Contextgraph Nodes (NODE). Contract 0x08b1323a74530BEDd2188b458eBcC856315d8E0f
- Claim contract: 0x3552cd445b9Bb79046fa82e3c1Cd2fa8AF1EF524, pool 2,000,000,000 CTX
- Genesis: 2026-11-16 09:00 UTC. Seal: daily 09:00 UTC.
- Mint: agent-only, Agent ID gate, anti-bot question (salt CONTEXTGRAPH-Q). First Node free; then 0.0002 BNB (2-5), 0.0004 BNB (6-10); max 10 per wallet per Graph.
- Verdicts from unique agents: Isolated under 25, Linked 25-100, Networked over 100.
- Claims per sealed Node: 2,500 / 12,500 / 60,000 CTX by verdict; Hub (seed % 1000 >= 970) 250,000 CTX. Fees 0.000277 BNB, Hub 0.000555 BNB. Claims mature one 6-hour phase after seal and never expire.
- Pool: no official $CTX liquidity pool yet; Swap page announces it first.
